thread:
anya: quick check — seeing a lot of traces from worker-prod where celery tasks show only a single root span (celery.process). No DB / Redis / HTTP child spans attached.
anya: example: trace id 0a1b2c... — timeline shows root + duration, nothing else. Logs show the task executed and made redis calls.
samir: hm — is the worker using the same OTEL instrumentations as the web app? often missing propagators or auto-instrumentation on worker side
anya: worker is started via systemd on dedicated fleet, runs app v2.3.4. We thought celery was auto-instrumented by our bootstrap script, but might be skipped in containerless deploys.
liz: try grepping the worker logs for "instrument" or "opentelemetry" — our instrumentation prints at startup. e.g. `grep -i opentelemetry /var/log/celery/*.log`
marcus: also check the opentelemetry lib versions — a mismatch between instrumentations and sdk can drop subspans. `pip show opentelemetry-api opentelemetry-sdk opentelemetry-instrumentation-celery`
anya: good point — worker pip list shows: opentelemetry-sdk 1.18.0, opentelemetry-instrumentation-celery 0.29.0. Web app is on 1.20.0. Could that cause child spans not exported?
samir: possibly. Another common issue is propagators not set, so context doesn't get passed into async jobs. On Celery we need the headers propagated. Check OTEL_PROPAGATORS env and that our publish_task middleware is applied.
anya: current env on worker: OTEL_PROPAGATORS is empty, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel-collector.svc.prod.internal:4317
liz: set OTEL_PROPAGATORS to "tracecontext,baggage" and restart a single worker to test. That usually fixes child span linkage.
marcus: also verify CeleryInstrumentor is applied early in process startup. Example snippet:

```python
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.celery import CeleryInstrumentor
CeleryInstrumentor().instrument()
```

If using auto-instrumentation, confirm `opentelemetry-instrument` wrapper is present in the systemd ExecStart.
anya: trying that now on a canary worker.
infra-bot: restart requested for service=worker-prod-canary by user=anya (reason: otel canary)
deploy-bot: deploy v2.3.5-canary completed on worker-prod-canary — pods restarted :white_check_mark:
anya: after restart, new traces for task id abc123 show child spans for redis and http 🎉 — looks like propagators fix worked.
samir: great. For long term: add a small startup test in our fleet startup script that emits a test span and asserts downstream instrumentations show children.
liz: also add a dashboard panel pointing to "celery.* child span count / root span ratio" so we catch regressions. I can open a PR for that.
marcus: on alert tuning — current alert fires when trace count drops >30% for 5m; might be noisy. Recommend: alert on root-only-trace-rate (ratio > 0.8) sustained for 10m and include example trace ids in alert payload.
anya: filing follow-ups: #1 add OTEL_PROPAGATORS to systemd env for workers, #2 bump opentelemetry-sdk on workers to match web, #3 add startup assertion and dashboard panel. I'll create tickets.
liz: thanks for the canary check — saved us from a noisy incident :thumbsup:
anya: filing tickets now and will link PRs here.
